_readme: Domains that rank in a local SERP but are not local businesses, and that the
automatic classifier provably cannot catch. Footprint separates platforms
(Yelp: 31M keywords) from local businesses (~500), but these sit in the same
range as genuine locals -- dunhamlaw.com (8,867, real Fort Worth lawyer) vs
muvr.io (9,687, national marketplace). No threshold works.
This is deliberately SMALL, EXPLICIT and REVIEWED, not the sprawling regex of
known aggregator names that this project already removed once. Every entry
carries a reason. Reviewed at each refresh (see docs/operations.md).
Excluded from COMPETITOR SETS only. These domains still appear in the graphs
as referring domains, which is where several of them are most interesting.

excluded.aligntech.com: manufacturer -- Align Technology makes Invisalign, not an orthodontist
excluded.iiat.org: trade association (Independent Insurance Agents of Texas) -- not a competitor, but a notable graph node
excluded.nahb.org: trade association (National Association of Home Builders)

_associations_note: Trade associations are excluded as competitors but are among the most
valuable nodes in the graph. naridallas.org links to 7 of the top 10 Dallas
remodelers. iiat.org and nahb.org are the same shape for their verticals.
Never filter these out of the referring-domain data.
